words.sense: Avoiding waste and using money and resources carefully while meeting real needs.
misconceptions: Treating every refusal to spend money as sensible thrift.

words.sense: Excessively unwilling to spend or give, even when spending is reasonable or necessary.
misconceptions: Assuming an economical decision must be stingy when the person can afford more.

semantic_axes.description: Frugal restraint saves resources without neglecting needs; parsimonious restraint withholds resources even when doing so is unreasonable.

edges.boundary_rule: Frugal restraint saves resources without neglecting needs; parsimonious restraint withholds resources even when doing so is unreasonable.
clues_a: spends when a real need arises
clues_b: lets others suffer to save trivial sums
refuses ordinary fairness despite having the means
irrelevant_clues: whether the person has a large income
whether the savings are counted precisely

misconceptions.M1: Treating every refusal to spend money as sensible thrift.
misconceptions.M2: Assuming an economical decision must be stingy when the person can afford more.
misconceptions.M3: Ignoring harm or unmet needs when deciding if restraint is excessive.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Khalid’s demand about shared sugar?

beats.text: Khalid insists that his housemate repay three cents for a spoonful of sugar, though money is not tight.
beats.decisive_clue: demands a negligible repayment without financial need
beats.reason: Demands a negligible repayment without financial need. Frugal restraint saves resources without neglecting needs; parsimonious restraint withholds resources even when doing so is unreasonable.

beats.text: He sends repeated reminders about those same three cents after being offered a fresh bag of sugar.
beats.decisive_clue: continues pursuing a trivial sum even after generous compensation
beats.reason: Continues pursuing a trivial sum even after generous compensation. Frugal restraint saves resources without neglecting needs; parsimonious restraint withholds resources even when doing so is unreasonable.

chains.feedback_short: Persistent demands over three cents show unwillingness far beyond sensible saving.
chains.feedback_deep: Frugal restraint saves resources without neglecting needs; parsimonious restraint withholds resources even when doing so is unreasonable. His refusal to let a negligible expense go is out of proportion to the amount.
chains.contrast_rule: Frugal restraint saves resources without neglecting needs; parsimonious restraint withholds resources even when doing so is unreasonable.
